person.name: Anant Chauhan
person.headline: AI/ML Engineer in Training | Student Lead, Smart India Hackathon 2026 | Design Lead, UPES OPEN Community
person.intro: Third-year B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) student at UPES, Dehradun. I build machine-learning and web projects, and I design for the communities I help run.

about: I'm a third-year B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at UPES, Dehradun, specialising in AI and Machine Learning. My interests run through computer vision, CNNs and NLP, and just as much through backend engineering and data structures and algorithms.

I interned at Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL) in an IT/SCADA environment, working on web and backend development and SCADA dashboard-related functionality. I have also interned with NextJob.ai.

Design is the other half of how I work. I lead design for the UPES OPEN Community, and I have held editorial, VFX and design roles across Hypervision, ACM and IEEE CS. This year I am also a student lead for Smart India Hackathon 2026 at UPES.
